readout_other: CSF tracer (BSA-Alexa Fluor 647) influx by macroscopic imaging and brain sections
direction_notes: LIFU at M1 increased CSF tracer influx in healthy mice; daily contralesional LIFU restored the stroke-reduced CSF influx on both sides. Neuronal excitability was not assessed.

exposures.label: LIFU at M1 (ipsilesional, contralesional or central cerebrum)

timing.protocol_description: Pulse train of 300 ms (2 ms pulses, 50% pulse-train duty cycle) every 2 s for a total of 10 min; the paper states an overall duty cycle of 7.5%. In the stroke experiments LIFU was applied daily for up to seven days to ipsilesional M1, contralesional M1 or central cerebrum.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Transcranial LIFU was applied through a commercial focused ultrasound transducer (H-104, Sonic Concepts, USA) placed at the M1 cortex of the brain (1 mm posterior and 3.5 mm lateral to the bregma) using the following parameters: center frequency = 0.5 MHz, pulse repetition frequency (PRF) = 250 kHz, pulse train  duration = 300 ms, pulse duration = 2 ms, duty cycle of pulse train = 50%, interstimulation interval = 2 s, and spatial peak temporal average intensities $( \mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } ) { = } 0 . 5 \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ total pulse train repetition duration = 10 min. These parameters were chosen based on previous LIFU neuromodulation studies [21].

source_quotes.n_subjects: Day 1: Control (n = 5), PT (n = 5), PT-LIFU (n = 6); Day 3: Control (n = 6), PT (n = 5), PT-LIFU (n = 6); Day 7: Control (n = 4), PT (n = 5), PT-LIFU (n = 6).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Based on the finding that only contralesional LIFU restored the ipsilesional CSF influx, LIFU was applied to the contralesional side for one, three, or seven consecutive days following stroke induction.

flags.reason: Paper states PRF = 250 kHz; with a 2 ms pulse at 50% this looks like a typo for 250 Hz. Recorded as written (250000 Hz).
50% is the duty cycle within the pulse train; the paper gives an overall duty cycle of 7.5% in the Discussion.
Pulse train duration 300 ms recorded; total repetition duration 10 min.
Only per-experiment group sizes are given across many figures; no total.
Experimenter could not be blinded to group.
